info.title: OPAGO public API transaction foundation v3 (BTC and HBAR Send/Receive)
info.description: Specification only. NOT a deployed API. Read spec.md; x-opago-* fields are normative. Buy, Sell, Fiat and Swap are later extensions.

servers.description: Deployment placeholder; set through trusted configuration.

AccountBearer.description: Keycloak account access token; issuer, audience, auth_time, tenant and party are verified in api-internal. On Path A operations it authorizes only a wallet without a user-held key (LNbits) that the account's party owns (spec.md 5.3, OQ-AUTH-5).

WalletBearer.description: Wallet session token from createWalletSession, scoped to one wallet, one installation and one ownership epoch.

PosBearer.description: Device credential of the registered, active POS device (pos_devices.api_key).

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: Bearer credential of the scheme the operation names. The facade copies it into X-Opago-User-Authorization for api-internal, which verifies it independently.

parameters.name: X-Opago-Contract
parameters.description: Selects this contract. The facade rejects a v3 path without it.

Retry-After.description: Delay in seconds when retry is appropriate; transient TME errors default to 5.

default.description: Business error; the HTTP status is the one the error catalog (errors.json) gives for the code.
